title: Bounded direct-image continuity with the specified coefficient action
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $R$ and $S$ be sheaves of commutative rings on the small pro-etale sites of $Y$ and $X$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], with a specified isomorphism $f^{-1}R\cong S$. Let $G:D(X,S)\to D(Y,R)$ be the ordinary uncompleted derived ringed direct image [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], with its $R$-action restricted along the adjoint map $R\to f_*S$. Let $I$ be a small filtered category in the coefficient universe [def-weil-size-convention], $D:I\to C(X,S)$ a diagram of cochain complexes, and $(v_i:D_i\to V)_{i\in I}$ any colimit cocone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Suppose there is $n\in\mathbb Z$ such that $D_i^j$ is a zero object for every $i\in I$ and $j<n$. Then for every $q\in\mathbb Z$ the canonical comparison
$$\mathop{\rm colim}_{i\in I} H^qG(QD_i)\longrightarrow H^qG(QV),$$
induced by the actual maps $H^qG(Qv_i)$, is an isomorphism of sheaves of $R$-modules. Here $Q$ denotes localization from cochain complexes to the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

proof.text: Factor the ordinary ringed module direct image as direct image carrying its natural f_*S-action followed by restriction along the actual adjoint ring map R → f_*S [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. The identity on the underlying presheaf of modules gives the natural isomorphism. Restriction composed with the forgetful functor is literally the forgetful functor for f_*S-modules. Preservation and reflection through these faithful forgetful functors [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful] show that restriction preserves finite limits, finite colimits and I-colimits.

proof.text: The universal property and uniqueness of right derived functors [def-sfb-right-derived-functor] identifies the standard right derived functor of direct image with its recorded construction by quasi-isomorphisms to K-injective complexes. The exact-right-factor comparison rightDerivedFunctorCompMapDerivedCategoryIso and the exact termwise factorization [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization], and commutation of exact functors with homology identify H^q G with ringHigherDirectImage followed by restriction. These are proved source-library functor comparison theorems, applied to the exact restriction functor of step 1.

proof.text: Apply boundedContinuityDirectImage [det-pe-bounded-continuity-direct-image] to D with its common lower bound. Its invertible canonical colimit desc says that the natural-coefficient higher direct image preserves the colimit of this particular diagram. Transport this preservation from the canonical colimit cocone to v. Apply the colimit-preserving restriction functor and the natural isomorphism of step 2. The resulting mapped cocone is colimiting, so its canonical desc is invertible. Its legs are precisely the given legs, without changing v.

theorem boundedContinuityDirectImage_coefficients
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (R : Sheaf (topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (S : Sheaf (topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R ≅ S)
    {I : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules X S) ℤ)
    (v : Cocone D) (hv : IsColimit v)
    (n : ℤ) (hD : ∀ i : I, ∀ j : ℤ, j < n → IsZero ((D.obj i).X j)) (q : ℤ) :
    IsIso (colimit.desc
      (D ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ proEtaleRingDerivedDirectImage f R S c ⋙
        DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q)
      ((DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ proEtaleRingDerivedDirectImage f R S c ⋙
        DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).mapCocone v))
